Confirm this answer submits the inspected observation, source version and fingerprint without a new preparation; exact receipt and readback preserve answer text, author and pin.
Reload reopens the same review/thread and automatically reuses the exact confirmed answer; storage version remains unchanged, so reuse creates no confirmation write.

Save answer edit advances only message version within the same incarnation; current body is visible, old selector returns 409 answer-selection-changed and old reuse returns 503 answer-reuse-unavailable.

gap_catalog.description: Four installed nominal RPT-01..04 journeys have not executed on an accepted composed W and request-only S. Every criterion remains NOT_RUN with empty runtime evidence.
Host/router/bootstrap/history/C05 binding and E2E tsconfig changes are inert proposals for session23. Their presence in receipt files is not installation or an accepted composition ACK.

Distinct-recipient proof needs a second legitimately admitted identity and real current recipient/source ACL lease. Existing local operator enrollment exposes one person; no grant/identity substitution is allowed.
Whole-session logout does not prove selective Talent, section, field or period capability denial/revocation. No restricted Talent values/labels/counts case is selected.

Current installed DOCX/PPTX bytes have no rendered page/slide or human visual inspection. OOXML completeness and historical rendered evidence do not prove current clipping, overlap, pagination or legibility.
No native desktop/private MCP invocation or UI/native/MCP handler, result, version and effect parity witness is present in the four nominal tests.
Automated Playwright clicks and visibility assertions do not provide observed human comprehension, task-completion timing, real participant usability or independent human acceptance.

No nominal test asserts review-comparison output, +80 delta, completed canonical action, removed-between-revisions project, first/no-predecessor result, partial authorization, incomparable currency/period/definition or expected-versus-observed result.

C05 answer confirmation/edit/history is distinct from capturing C06 comment version3 in a review, advancing the live thread to4 and reopening/exporting the unchanged captured comment. That exact comment capture case is absent.
Source edits precede meeting open/reopen. No assertion observes an update while the meeting is already open or an explicit update-available indicator without replacing its capture.
RPT-03 removes one project from selection while its source remains unchanged. Actual source deletion or disappearance after preservation is not exercised.
No meeting closure action asserts preservation of the financial basis plus chosen decisions, conditions, notes, canonical follow-ups/actions or expected-versus-observed decision outcomes.
No financial trajectory/chart series is selected and no unavailable/partial chart is exported. An empty Hot Topics collection is not a missing-series chart case.
The nominal tests do not witness C16 descriptor production and T06 consumer execution for sf_review_prepare/sf_report_prepare/sf_artifact_get with real operation references.

Complete resident 5/18/8/C17 obligations, all18 skill loads/consumer witnesses, independent reviewer and integrated AM/G7/G8 evidence are not established by the four nominal tests or compile/bundle checks.
No nominal case exercises failed/aborted preservation, idempotent resubmission of the same preserve command, lost ACK, or prevents an unsaved/transient preview from being reported as saved.

Only selected Dashboard topics are exercised. Planner/Procurement selection and nonplain C05 comments/external outcomes/decisions/calculations/documents need their actual producer contracts and protected leases.
Completely empty selection, unknown topic, malformed/stale/removed source selector and missing/deleted artifact are not exercised as a complete negative matrix.
No existing human agenda comments are inserted then retained through reorder/remove. Project notes are source fields, not agenda comments or captured C06 commentary.
The legacy Reports form is exercised as entry into preserved Review. Independent live-data legacy export behavior and its authorization matrix are not exercised.
The preview, table and OOXML checks do not prove all visual topic/count/comment presentations, executive-summary semantics, user-supplied report title propagation or every final meeting topic.

The matrix of authorized, direct-without-grant, stale and unavailable calls to each task export is incomplete; unrelated C06 stale-answer negatives cannot substitute for sf_review_prepare or artifact/export negatives.
